question: To whom may this Kaula teaching be given and to whom must it be denied?
premises: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy.
It should not be given indiscriminately.
The prohibition applies to just anyone.
inference: This Kaula teaching must be given only to the worthy and not to just anyone.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy, but it must not be given to just anyone.
